rules.yaml_help: Use source: value, value_variation or value_transition. An empty or omitted attribute targets the entity state; a filled attribute targets that attribute. Variations require condition_template and compare current_value - starting_value. Variations and transitions do not support wildcard attributes. between/outside use value: [lower, upper]. source: unchanged monitors state and attributes together; source: jinja only evaluates condition_template. Legacy sources are migrated automatically.
rules.labels_help: Home Assistant labels added to the entity and device labels for notifications.
rules.transition_help: Requires an observed departure → arrival transition. The trigger delay holds the arrival value; automatic resolution starts at activation. Confirmed repeats extend it without clearing acknowledgment. No recovery notification is sent.
